findings.what: amanatar/optimized-biohub-max-score started a new version at 13:18 UTC 26 Sep (CLI status RUNNING at ~15:18; votes 53->58). It is now #2 in the competition scoreDescending list, but the page still shows the last successful run: 'Version 1 of 5', 'Public Score 0.910', 'Best Score 0.953 V4'. The latest source (v10) is v9 plus five 'ceiling-breaker' levers, all default OFF: count_oracle (node budget from estimated_number_of_nodes), div_lineage (daughter completion), gap_predict (2-4 frame constant-velocity bridging), stitch (endpoint stitching) and margin_repair (low-margin parent re-assignment). They are enabled only by the validator-gated PP sweep on held-out TRAIN stems (os.environ BIOHUB_VALIDATOR_ENABLE = "1"), with REPAIR_DEADLINE_S 27000 as in x138. By E10 P4b(d) this is not portable (validator/PP sweep present), and every lever family is closed for us (I-149 count-target prune, stitch, gap LAP/sandwich, and division completion ~ insertion). The source was pulled.
